name: Irodori-TTS
description: Aratako's Irodori-TTS-Server — Japanese; reference voices and Voice Design. Its tuning goes in the request's `irodori` object.

options.label: Steps (num_steps)
options.description: More steps: finer audio, slower synthesis.

options.label: Seed
options.description: The same seed gives the same rendition (without a reference voice it does not fix the speaker). Blank: different each time.

options.label: Steadiness (truncation_factor)
options.description: Lower: a steadier, less varied voice.

options.label: Reference voice strength (speaker_kv_scale)
options.description: How closely the reference voice is followed.
